funds_data.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in asset-backed securities. Under normal circumstances, the Advisor intends to invest predominately in investment grade rated asset-backed securities and unrated instruments considered by the Adviser to be of comparable credit quality. The fund is non-diversified.
